raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since DE-398 (2026-01-16), silver_transactions derives txn_date from CAST(ingest_ts AS DATE), but ingest_ts is always the next day at 02:00 after txn_ts, so txn_date mismatches the transaction date. All 4699 POSTED rows fail the monitor, which matches the count exactly. Deriving txn_date from CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) restores the column's meaning and the DATE_CONSISTENCY invariant, and the gold tables rebuild from the corrected silver table.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
